title: OneDrive and SharePoint: anchored comments in the PDF viewer on the web
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts match the roadmap, and Microsoft documents the file-commenting command and the product licensing it cites. Feature-specific licensing, comment storage and an admin UI remain undocumented in the searches performed. The impact rating should be high under the wiki's scale because the feature is on by default.
